parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_hierarchy to define the compound set from parent CHEMBL95 including parent and all salts. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno. Join docs on doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id over doi. Join activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id to retrieve assay_description. Join target_dictionary on tid to retrieve target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter for target CHEMBL220 and standard_type IC50 with units nM. Return all rows without limit.
